descriptions.Macro: macroeconomic release such as CPI, jobs report, GDP, FOMC meeting, Federal Reserve interest-rate decision, central bank policy, or inflation data
descriptions.Geopolitical: geopolitical event such as a war, sanctions, election outcome, country-level ban, martial law, tariffs, or sovereign action that affects financial markets
descriptions.Regulatory_Legal: regulatory action, SEC or CFTC lawsuit, enforcement, court ruling, legislation, ETF approval as a regulatory milestone, or government policy change
descriptions.Security_Crime: exchange hack, smart-contract exploit, ransomware, fraud, theft, scam, money laundering charge, or arrest of a crypto operator
descriptions.Institutional_Flows: ETF inflow or outflow, corporate Bitcoin treasury purchase by a public company like MicroStrategy, BlackRock or Fidelity fund flow, institutional allocation, or country-level adoption
descriptions.Protocol_Infrastructure: blockchain protocol upgrade, hard fork, halving, Lightning Network change, mining difficulty or hash-rate event, or developer activity affecting Bitcoin or Ethereum
descriptions.OnChain_Flows: on-chain or exchange flow event such as whale movement, long-term holder transfer, exchange reserve change, wallet flows, large liquidation cascade, exchange outage, proof-of-reserves disclosure, or CryptoQuant or Glassnode metric release
descriptions.Product_Adoption: new product launch, wallet integration, payment-rail partnership, merchant adoption, or commercial product release
descriptions.Market_Commentary: backward-looking analysis of crypto price action that does not report any new triggering event, such as technical analysis, chart pattern commentary, price-target columns, or daily market recaps that only describe moves already in progress
descriptions.Opinion_Editorial: opinion essay, op-ed, philosophical commentary, or thought-leadership argument about the long-run future of crypto
descriptions.Other: celebrity gossip, sponsored content, awards, conferences, or topics that do not fit any of the above event types
